sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.text: IT consultant profile working at the boundary between business and technology. Since 2019 I have analysed business processes, determined what customers actually need, and translated those requirements into working software - from writing user stories with clients to designing and building the architecture behind them. At an online-marketing agency I led and coordinated web and programming projects and handed structured tasks to a development team; on a long-running open-source project I coordinate a ten-person team. I now integrate LLMs and AI agents into real development workflows, which gives me practical grounding to advise on where AI genuinely helps a business and where it does not. I prefer to understand a system end to end, measure results, and keep improving it. I am openly building out the strategy side of consulting: AI governance, the EU AI Act, change management and workshop facilitation.

items.title: AI-Assisted Software Development
bullets: Translate requirements from executive management and the Product Owner into features, specified as Gherkin/BDD scenarios, for a greenfield restaurant point-of-sale (POS) system
Design the software architecture (Laravel/PostgreSQL backend, TypeScript and Alpine.js frontend), balancing maintainability, performance and security
Integrate AI tools - LLMs and agents - into daily development for code analysis, architecture design, code generation and automation; practical evidence for advising on AI adoption
Maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitLab and containerization with Docker; test automation with Codeception and PHPUnit

items.title: Application Development & Project Coordination
bullets: Determined customer needs and derived the necessary measures; analysed business processes and conditions in the respective application area (business-process analysis)
Led and coordinated web, programming and online-marketing projects; formulated programming tasks, handed them to the team, and reviewed and approved the results
Conceived requirements-appropriate software solutions and developed custom applications (ticketing systems, web applications, marketing tools), adapting and extending existing software
Wrote user stories together with the development team and clients; owned client communication and coordination
Planned and optimized database systems; test automation with PHPUnit

items.title: Development & Team Coordination
bullets: Coordinate a ten-person team and align technical with organizational tasks
Analyse complex legacy dependencies and identify technical dependencies without existing documentation
Document technical processes and maintain a knowledge base and rule set in MediaWiki

items.title: AI Engineering Experiments
bullets: Built and evaluated AI workflows, agents and integrations to understand production use of LLMs rather than only prompting
Designed agent workflows, optimized prompts and token usage, and compared model strengths against cost/quality trade-offs
Foundation for honest AI-adoption advice: where AI adds measurable value to a business process and where it does not
